lines.en: This is rare.
Not the fact that I’m walking home with the three girls who I’d likely wind up dragging along with me to a desert island if I was forced to choose- but the fact that we’re surrounded by water.
Which, I guess, is not that dissimilar from actually being stuck on a desert island. Apart from the fact that the ocean is currently crashing down around us.
What I’m trying to say is that it’s raining.
I’m sorry I couldn’t put it any more eloquently — I’ve just gotten so accustomed to the fact that the rain doesn’t ever hit us that I’ve all but abandoned the idea of ever having to talk about it.
That said, we’re lucky Ayane is always prepared and had not one but two umbrellas stashed away in her locker for emergency scenarios like this.
If the weather reports are accurate (Which they’re normally not), this won’t be the last time either.
It’s supposed to rain a lot more frequently in the coming days.
It makes sense, of course, what with our rainy season being all but devoid of actual rain until now.
But life is changing.
I told you that recently, didn’t I?
And with that change in life comes a change in the world because those two things are so connected at this point that one can not move without the other.
That doesn’t mean I have to like it. I honestly hate the feeling of my clothes getting wet.
I hate how they stick to my skin.
But-
I hate the heat even more.
And so I will accept the precipitation in place of perspiration and walk forward into puddle after puddle, drenching my shoes and socks.
I could try to avoid them all, but there’s simply no point.
We can’t get off this island without getting wet.
And we can’t live normal lives without a little downpour every now and then.
Here’s to the rainy season.
And here’s to hoping it doesn’t all freeze just yet.
: I think I really have a chance, Ayane! I’m starting to get pretty good at this whole poetry thing!
: I believe in you, Ami! I knew your educational breakthrough was only a hop, skip, and a jump away! And, despite what many workforces would have you believe, poetry totally counts as “educational!”
: I just hope Miss Watabe likes it. She’s a pretty harsh judge from what I hear.
: I heard from Noriko a while ago that she graded this one girl’s essay so harshly that she started bawling her eyes out and ran out of class.
: Sensei, can I ask you a question?
: I guess. It’s not like Ami and Ayane are paying any attention to us.
: Then, would you mind explaining to me why I’m walking under your umbrella?
: In as few words as possible, preferably.
: Because Ayane said she wanted to walk with Ami.
: I know that. I was there when she said it. What I am asking is why you agreed.
: In a way that doesn’t make you sound like a disgusting opportunist, preferably.
: Can we just stay silent? Not talking to you seems like the easiest option in a situation like this.
: Was my direct questioning a little too harsh?
: If you want to know why we were paired up, ask Ayane. I don’t know what to tell you.
: May I at least hold the umbrella so I can walk ahead of you in complete disregard for your well-being?
: No. But if you want to run ahead without it, feel free.
: How unfortunate. It appears that since I can’t move ahead without running the risk of coming down with a cold, you and I are forced to stick together for the time being.
: Oh well. I suppose that it’s fine since there is no other option.
Is this just Maya’s weird, secret way of expressing how much she cares about me without...you know, saying anything about how much she cares about me?
Because it feels to me like she’s only asking these things right now to-
: Ami, what are you looking at?
Hold on. No. I was narrating. You can’t just-
: Look over there...in the middle of the road.
Ugh, fine. Since I’m apparently not allowed to talk about my thoughts anymore, I guess I’ll-
Wait...
Isn’t that-
: Isn’t that Kaori?
Can I not even get a thought out anymore?
: What’s Kaori doing out in the street?
: Better question — who is Kaori and why do we care?
: She works at the diner, doesn’t she?
: She works everywhere. That’s like, her whole thing. She even helped me and Uta out at the maid cafe once.
: You’re friends with her...aren’t you, Sensei? Is this normal for Kaori? Or should we, like...do something about it?
: Excellent question, Ami.
: I have absolutely no idea.
: But, if I were to rank everyone I know on their likelihood to stand out in the middle of the street during a storm, Kaori would probably come out on top.
: That said, we should probably still do something.
: Uhh...Kaori? Are you okay?
: She’s clearly insane. Let’s just leave.
: Kaori? Hello? Can you hear us?
: Friend?
: Waterfall?
: Oh. I think that worked.
: Burgerfriend Friendman Burger? Innocently attractive cute maid girl who he abducted? What are you doing here?
: I actually like that nickname for you, Ami.
: Kaori, you were just...standing in the middle of the street during a storm. What’s going on?
: I was doing what?
: Reverse-sitting on an asphalt car-bed while letting clear sky-fluid bounce off of your...head flesh?
: Ahh! Why did you not just say so?! Do not be so needlessly acute triangle next time!
: Okay, what the actual fuck is going on right now?
: It is nice to see you again, Smaller Friend! I enjoy the yellow plastic fluid-blocker your equally-yellow companion has! It is a great thing to have on days like today! This day!
: Do you...not have an umbrella, Kaori?
: Better question, when did Maya get my umbrella?
: Secret.
: I do not possess what you refer to as the “umbrella.” I have never had a need for one until this day.
: Maybe...stay inside then? You’re going to get sick if you walk around in the rain, Kaori.
: Then all I must do is remain still! The answer is obvious!
: Where did you find this creature and what is wrong with it?
: That won’t do either, Kaori! You shouldn’t be out here in the first place.
: Yeah, why are you out here? Shouldn’t you be at work?
: I am! But I am not! It is hard to explain!
: Do you remember when you helped Aunt Yukiburger and me hand out paper advertisements for the Sara? It is like that!
: You’re handing out fliers?
: They are called birds! And no! Paper advertisements!
: You don’t...have any paper advertisements, though.
: Then I will pat myself on the backwards stomach for a work well worked and return to base!
: And which planet is your “base” on?
: Where are you working today, Kaori? Do you want us to walk you back? You can hang out under the waterblocker with me and Ayane.
: That would be very helpful, Smaller Friend!
: Today, I am working in a building full of fruit and cream! A bright building! Where creatures like you contort and mutate your face into happier versions of the same face!
: Oh, so you do know the word “face” after all. I wish I knew that earlier.
: Fruit and cream? Is it nearby?
: The length of seven rock-throws!
: Seven rock-throws...I see, I see...
: Do you?
: The only place around here that matches that description, unless Kaori has the arm strength of a professional outfielder, would be that cafe we took Ami to for her birthday a while back.
: What birthday was that? I don’t remember that at all.
: You don’t? Really? It should have been your-
: Let us go! I will inform the manager that I did the job so she will give me another job! One with less fluids and more cream!
: Both of those jobs sound pretty good to me.
: I understand your words! There are few things better than a mouth full of cream!
: She’s got a point there.
Ayane doesn’t say that, but I can tell she’s thinking it.
: It’s not far, right? Because if it’s only seven rock-throws away, we might as well wait out the rain there. Beats having to share umbrellas at least.
: Are you only saying that because you want to see Kaori with a mouth full of cream?
: I can not cream myself until the day ends! I must wait until the customers are creamed first!
: You heard her, Ami. You’re the one getting creamed, not Kaori. That should be fine, right?
: Getting creamed does sound tempting right now. Better than just staying wet, at least.
: I would also like to get creamed right now.
Again, Ayane doesn’t say that. But she’s thinking it.
: Why is everyone just ignoring all of these blatant innuendos?
: Why are you being such a buzzkill when there is now food involved? You love food.
: Because I don’t have any money and Ayane refuses to buy me anything unhealthy.
: I will not stand idly by while you destroy your adorable-
: Just agree and I’ll buy you whatever you want.
: What are we waiting for? Let’s go.
: Okay, Kaori! Take us back to your base and cream us all!
: I understand! Prepare to be creamed, small child!
Kaori marches onward and the rest of us follow behind her.
Unfortunately though, there are no rocks around...so I am unable to discern just how much further we’ll need to walk.
Fortunately, it winds up not being very far at all and, after a few blocks, the five of us wind up escaping the rain and finding refuge in a shop that smells a little too sweet for me.
I do have a vague recollection of coming here once or twice before, but these sorts of cafes have never really had much effect on-
: Arrival!
Okay, does no one care about my narration today?
: Thank you for your sudden and wet appearance inside of my humble rectangle! Please hand to me your paper advertisement for a discounted rate on the creaming!
: You didn’t give us any, Kaori. You were all out when we found you.
: Then only the Burger-man gets a discount for being my friend! I am sorry, Smaller Friend and blue-eyed companion. Your time will come another day!
: That’s fine. I was going to pay for Ami anyway.
: You were? Why? I have money. You don’t have to do that.
: Do you still do the couple’s discount here, Kaori? Smaller Friend and I are dating and we’d like the most private table you have.
: We do not have privacy wood for customers to eat off of, but we do support love in the form of financial benefit!
: Reverse-stand wherever you like and I will be with you momentarily!
: Guess that leaves-
: And she sat down without me.
: Is something the matter Burger McBurger Friend McBurgerFriend McFriend Man Burger?
: Are you sad that you will not be receiving financial benefits in the name of love? Because we have a loneliness special as well!
: You’d think something like that would help, but really it just makes me feel even more alone.
: Well, go be alone at a rectangular wooden slab! Your large and handsome frame is blocking the doorway and will make it harder for me to cream the customers who walk in!
: Hah...
: What are you doing? Why are you sitting here? I specifically sat here so I wouldn’t have to deal with you.
: Wasn’t I supposed to pay for you? That’s the only reason you came here in the first place, isn’t it?
: I kind of hoped you would just walk across the cafe and hand me money when I got the check.
: What’s the problem? Why can't I sit here?
: The problem is that Ami is here too. And if she sees the two of us at a table together, she is going to get suspicious and it is going to make my life even more hellish than it already is.
: That’s not going to happen.
: That is absolutely going to happen.
: No, it’s fine. Look. Ayane is distracting her.
: Are you excited to eat your cake, Ami?
: I am! It looks super delicious! Thank you so much, Ayane!
: Great, great.
: Now, tell me, what are your thoughts on the apocalypse?
: What?
: I really hope they’re not talking about what I think they’re talking about...
: They’re almost certainly talking about what you think they’re talking about.
: Hah...she’s going to ruin everything, Sensei. I can feel it.
: You’ve felt a lot of things and only a few of them have wound up being true.
: No...A few of them have wound up being wrong. Need I remind you that nearly all of my predictions up until recently had been spot-on?
: Or is that just what you were programmed to think?
: You know, I really...really wish Tsuneyo never mentioned something like that. Because you might be joking now, but that has stuck with me and I can’t get it out of my head.
: Just think about that time we almost kissed instead. I’m sure that’ll overwrite it.
: Yeah, with more earth-shattering loneliness and an even greater desire to brutally and violently make up for lost time in your bedroom.
: You know, I’ve waited a long time to hear you say things like that, but now that you do say things like that, it’s just weird.
: You did this to yourself. If you’re going to make me suffer every single day of my life, the least I can do is make you suffer as well.
: Well, it’s working. So...keep at it, I guess.
: Maya?
: God, I fucking hate this.
: Hello, Friend! I regret to inform you that there is no hot meat! But there is plenty of-
: Cream. Yes, Kaori. I know.
: How would you like to be creamed?
: Brutally and violently in my bedroom by a girl who likes watermelons a little too much.
: Die.
: Your words apart from “watermelon” do not register in my brain-space, but I will explain your characteristics to the manager and have them guess what you would like to consume based on that!
: Is there anything else you require?
: Not for me. Thanks, though.
: I understand! Please be patient for others must be creamed first!
: Is there a menu I could-
: ...look at?
: What just happened?
: It looks like you were ignored.
: But...I’ve never been ignored in my life. I’m adorable. Can you see me? You can see how adorable I am, right?
: I can see how humble you are.
: What do I do now?
: Starve, I guess.
: Call her back over. She’s your friend, isn’t she?
: Ugh...fine.
: Kaori.
: Eleven!
: That’s...nice. Aren’t you forgetting something, though?
: The Queen of Spiders does not forget. She knows the answers to all things even before she asks.
: Then...why did you ask?...
: I need a menu. Either that or a...recommendation or-
: Friend, as much as I enjoy the feeling of my vision balls connecting with yours, I have customers to cream. So if you do not have something to ask for-
: A...menu would be fine, Kaori. Thank you.
: Shiny, plastic-coated list of sustenance, coming right up! Prepare for another rectangle!
: Wha-
: I fucking hate your weird friend.
: Maybe you just have to speak her language.
: And make myself sound like a complete idiot? No thanks. You’ll order for me. And I’ll be having one of everything on the menu. I hope you’re happy.
: As long as you’re happy-
: Don’t hit on me when I’m angry. Or hungry. Or ever.
: What? What’s that stupid fucking face for? What are you thinking?
: I’m just wondering if hate sex would count toward potentially deleting me.
: It would.
: But-
: Trust me.
: It would.
: I guess I’ll just take your word for it...
In the end, Maya never gets to communicate with our waitress.
But, to be fair, I think she’d have failed if she’d gotten a chance anyway.
Kaori isn’t exactly the easiest person to talk to, but...that’s kicked up a few notches when she won’t even acknowledge you.
Thankfully (For Maya, not my wallet), I’m able to order on behalf of the bottomless pit and we all proceed to HAVE A NORMAL, FUN MEAL BEFORE RETURNING HOME.
Maya’s affection has increased to [maya_love]!
Kaori’s affection has increased to [kaori_love]!
it is waking up
